# Statuscake

StatusCake is a website monitoring platform that provides observability for applications, offering features like uptime monitoring, page speed monitoring, SSL monitoring, and more.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/statuscake/.

## Actions

- **Delete Contact Group**: Delete a contact group.
- **Delete Test**: Delete a statuscake test.
- **Get All Contact Groups** (read-only): Retrieve all contact groups.
- **Get All Monitoring Locations** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all monitoring locations.
- **Get All PageSpeed Tests** (read-only): Retrieve all pagespeed tests.
- **Get All Tests** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all tests.
- **Get Heartbeat Checks** (read-only): List heartbeat checks.
- **Get SSL Checks** (read-only): Retrieve a list of ssl checks.
- **Update Contact Group**: Update an existing contact group.
- **Get Contact Group Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific contact group.
- **Get SSL Check Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific ssl check.
